Account background:
- Institutional ledger provider for post-trade workflows; latency-sensitive customer-facing chat + automated reconciliation agents.
- Heavy regulatory constraints (EU/US data residency splits), encryption at-rest + KMS for key separation.
- On-prem cluster for highest-sensitivity workloads; VPC peering for less-sensitive dev/test.

Engagement summary:
- 2026-02-25 discovery (ff-2026-02-25-amberhaven-intro): intro call w/ CTO (R. Patel), Head of Infra (M. Sorensen), ML lead (J. Alvarez). Pain: unpredictable token costs + unpredictable p95 latency during market open spikes.

- 2026-03-05 sizing workshop (ff-2026-03-05-sizing-workshop): attended by Redwood SE (Lucas), AE (Priya), Amberhaven infra + quant teams. Ran baseline workload across representative prompts.

Sizing workshop outputs (notes):
- Baseline steady-state: 120 QPS for short-turn chat endpoints (avg completion length 40 tokens). Observed token/sec steady-state ~4,800 tokens/sec aggregate.
- Peak (market-open bursts): short bursts up to 700 QPS for 30-90s windows; token/sec peaks ~28k tokens/sec.
- Reranking job batch: nightly rerank job processes ~6M documents; throughput requirement: 2,000 documents/min during nightly window. Can be scheduled flexibly to avoid peak.
- Desired latency SLOs: 95th <= 220ms for chat short completions; p99 budget 450ms. Business: sub-250ms perceived as 'snappy' by traders.
- Model preference: mix of Llama-3-70B-quant (for complex summaries) + 13B low-latency variant for chat. Wants automatic routing/fallback to smaller model for bursts.

Reserved GPU planning (initial proposal):
- Steady reserved baseline: 8 A100-class GPUs (quantized kernels) estimated to meet 120 QPS steady-state with caching/batching.
- Burst capacity: +autoscale pool of 6 GPUs for short windows, or routed fallback to Redwood Hosted for non-sensitive bursts.
- On-prem: request for 4-node on-prem cluster (NVIDIA H100 equivalent) dedicated to highest-sensitivity tenants.
- KV cache sizing: large prefix cache recommended; estimate 1TB KV per region for market-history prompts.

SLA / commercial asks raised by Amberhaven:
- 99.95% uptime for Dedicated control plane + 99.9% inference availability for reserved baseline.
- Throughput guarantee: committed baseline QPS with credits for any shortfalls.
- Clear escalation path and dedicated SE during market-critical windows.
- Data residency + audit log retention 7 years for trade-related prompts.
